drainageSource: Design choice: percolation of 2 in/hr or more is fast, 0.5 to 2 moderate, under 0.5 slow.
containerSource: Assumption: typical nursery root ball sizes by container.

hole.source: Common planting guidance: dig about twice the root ball width and as deep as the root ball.

amendment.source: Assumption: 25% compost in the backfill, skipped for plants that need sharp drainage (many California natives resent amended soil).

mulch.source: Common guidance: 3 in of mulch. Plants outside a bed get a ring.

rootableSoil.source: Urban tree guidance often cited at about 2 cu ft of soil per sq ft of canopy. Verify before relying on it.

raisedBed.source: Assumption: fill stops 3 in below the rim.
